title: Decouple Reasoning Mindmap From Puzzle 2d
description: D4: reasoning/mindmap/plugin/rs/lib.rs currently has `use puzzle_2d::Puzzle2dExtension;` and a local `PUZZLE2D_FIXTURE_SCHEMA` shadow-const, plus a direct call to `puzzle_2d::apply_force_graph_layout_to_fixture_v1_json`. Decouple mindmap from puzzle_2d per C6 (no app-to-app plugin deps): (1) mindmap's board schema should be its own "reasoning.mindmap.fixture" (already the domain crate's `MINDMAP_BOARD_SCHEMA` intent and already recognized by the neutral graph crate's schema allowlist and puzzle_2d's own undirected-routing check) rather than literally "puzzle.2d.fixture"; (2) the force-graph-layout call is a genuinely shared MECHANISM that already lives in a neutral crate (`infinite_board_port_directed`, which puzzle_2d itself only re-exports) — depend on that neutral crate directly instead of on puzzle_2d. Remove puzzle_2d from reasoning/mindmap/plugin/rs/Cargo.toml.
summary:
Decoupled reasoning/mindmap/plugin/rs from puzzle_2d (C6). Used strategy 1 (own schema) for the fixture-schema coupling and strategy 2 (depend on the neutral crate directly) for the force-graph-layout mechanism — both targets already existed, no new crate needed. Removed `use puzzle_2d::Puzzle2dExtension;` (was dead: only instantiated, never used, in one test) and the local `PUZZLE2D_FIXTURE_SCHEMA` shadow-const ("puzzle.2d.fixture"); mindmap's board fixture now uses `reasoning_mindmap::MINDMAP_BOARD_SCHEMA`, which itself was corrected from "puzzle.2d.fixture" to "reasoning.mindmap.fixture" — mindmap's own schema, already anticipated by the neutral `infinite_board_normal_undirected` crate's `FORCE_GRAPH_COMPATIBLE_SCHEMAS` allowlist, by puzzle_2d's own `is_undirected_fixture_schema` routing check, and by the checked-in metabolism.wires.json fixture (which already carried "reasoning.mindmap.fixture" on its board sub-object but was being silently overwritten to "puzzle.2d.fixture" every time — this was a latent bug: mindmap boards were going through puzzle's directed force-graph path instead of the correct undirected physics for mindmap's schema). Replaced the direct `puzzle_2d::apply_force_graph_layout_to_fixture_v1_json` call with `infinite_board_port_directed::apply_force_graph_layout_to_fixture_v1_json` — the same underlying function (puzzle_2d only re-exported it from this neutral crate), now depended on directly instead of through puzzle's app-plugin-adjacent crate. Also deleted `default_empty_wires_fixture`/`default_empty_board_fixture`, which were byte-for-byte duplicates of `reasoning_mindmap::empty_wires_fixture`/`empty_board_fixture` (now imported and called directly) — pure dedup enabled by fixing the schema constant. Updated Cargo.toml: removed `puzzle_2d` dependency, added `infinite_board_port_directed = { path = "../../../../infinite/board/port/directed/rs" }`. Renamed the test `wires_fixture_board_uses_puzzle_schema` -> `wires_fixture_board_uses_mindmap_schema` and dropped its dead `Puzzle2dExtension` instantiation.

Verified: grep-confirmed zero `puzzle_2d`/`Puzzle2dExtension`/`PUZZLE2D_FIXTURE_SCHEMA` references remain anywhere under reasoning/mindmap/. Manually traced every renamed/moved identifier (MINDMAP_BOARD_SCHEMA, empty_board_fixture, empty_wires_fixture are all `pub` in reasoning_mindmap; infinite_board_port_directed::apply_force_graph_layout_to_fixture_v1_json has the identical `(&str, &str) -> Result<String, String>` signature as the puzzle_2d re-export it replaces, since it's literally the same function). Confirmed `infinite/board/port/directed/rs` exists at the expected relative path and is already a workspace dependency elsewhere (puzzle_2d and infinite_board_port_directed_normal both already build against it), so no new dependency-graph risk. Confirmed via grep that no TS/JS consumer under reasoning/mindmap/ parses the board "schema" string, and that `build_canvas_2d_scene` only consumes extracted layer/camera arrays, not the raw fixture's schema field, so the schema-string change is safe for the canvas render path. Diffed edited files against pre-edit backups in this ticket folder line-by-line and confirmed brace balance (168/168 in plugin lib.rs, 117/117 in domain lib.rs). `rustfmt --check` was run but is unreliable here: it reports ~530 diff lines against the *pristine pre-edit* file too (confirmed by running it against the backup), i.e. this file was never in sync with standalone single-file rustfmt in this repo (likely needs `cargo fmt -p` context) — not a regression from this change, so relied on manual diff/structural review instead. `cargo check -p reasoning-mindmap-plugin -p reasoning_mindmap` was started but sat with zero output past the 2-3 minute budget (shared cargo-lock contention from other concurrent sessions per repo norm) — left running in background, not blocked on; leaving final compile verification to the orchestrator's end-of-program gate as instructed.

Flag for Wave 4 audit: reasoning/mindmap/rs/lib.rs (the mindmap domain crate, not plugin/rs) also needed a one-line schema-constant fix (MINDMAP_BOARD_SCHEMA) to make the decoupling coherent — this crate is a sibling of my assigned reasoning/mindmap/plugin/rs but not literally inside it; touched it because the plugin's local shadow-const was reusing this domain constant's (mis-set) value, and leaving it at "puzzle.2d.fixture" would have made the "own schema" fix a no-op. Also noticed two other concurrently-open tickets that touch adjacent surface: 26/07/18/GENERALIZE-PUZZLE2D-BOARD-SURFACE-TO-BOARD2D and 26/07/18/NORMALIZE-REASONING-MINDMAP-PLUGIN-TO-CONSISTENCY-CONTRACT — did not coordinate with them, worth reconciling at the final gate in case of overlapping edits to puzzle/2d/rs or reasoning/mindmap/plugin/rs.
